preserved: Original contract, 68 case objects, requirements, commands, three correction batches and original global limits remain unchanged except the explicit clarifications below.
selection: An actual trusted observation may record the authorized lead's routine selection, with exact issue/scope/source/digest and installation binding. It is not necessarily a new human click and never establishes human acceptance. No model-facing boolean or prose instruction creates this observation.
transaction_guard: Product Database connections carry a trusted enrolled-store guard. Verify actual connection store UUID plus owned file identity after opening/BEGIN and before commit. The composition check is additional. On mismatch roll back the actual connection, refusing new claims/effects. Do not claim a distributed lock or protection from an adversarial filesystem actor beyond the owned installation boundary.
ownership_delta: docs/test_status_report.md is excluded from worker edits; the lead owns that report and receives final evidence.
